title: alnus jorullensis var. castaneifolia
intro: Alnus jorullensis var. castaneifolia, commonly known as Mexican red alder, is a plant species in the birch family Betulaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its purported health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help to reduce fever and alleviate symptoms of colds and flu. The therapeutic actions of Mexican red alder include antimicrobial and antiseptic activities, which may aid in wound healing and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
